notes: Posted 31 May 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.
Byline 'Jesus "Savior" Christ' is a joke name, so the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle Savior as plain text (no player page).

Starting cards as posted under Starting (10): There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him, Endor: Chief Chirpa's Hut, Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay), Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight, Luke's Lightsaber, I Feel The Conflict, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Ultimatum, Don't Do That Again and Draw Their Fire; these count toward the 60. I Feel The Conflict is the starting Effect because the Objective deploys it.

The list uses joke names for several cards. Posted 'Lukes Massive Penis' (in Starting) dested Luke's Lightsaber, which the Objective deploys with Luke; 'Qui Gons Detachable Penis' dested Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber (Tatooine; Qui-Gon's Lightsaber is Reflections III, later); 'Obi Wans Shiny Massive Tool' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber; all three are posted under 'Green (3)' (weapons) with Mercenary Armor.

Posted 'Obi Wan, Padawan Learner w/out Penis' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; 'Obi Wan with really Massive Penis' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Leia with Tool x2' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle (the only Leia-with-a-weapon card then); 'Corran Horny' dested Corran Horn; 'Chewbacca with Gun' dested Chewie With Blaster Rifle; 'Han with Gun' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Wookie' dested Wookiee.

Posted 'Endor Back Door ,Lukes Sex Hideout' dested Endor: Back Door; 'Dont Do That Again, save it for tonight' dested the Effect Don't Do That Again; 'Do or Not Do Combo' dested Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'Houjx Combo' dested Houjix & Out Of Nowhere; 'Tatooine Mos Espa' dested the Light Tatooine: Mos Espa.
'Other (1)' is a section header, not a card. The one card under it, 'Anakins Machine', dested Anakin's Podracer (the only Anakin card that fits an 'Other' section).
Draw Their Fire is posted twice (in Starting and under Effects); both copies are kept. The Effects section says (7) but lists 8 cards.
The list adds to 65, not 60; kept as published.
